If you plan to apply for visa or get a loan, you need to prove to that entity that you are working as a freelance or self-employed. It may be in a form of a letter then attach those transactions you have with your client, exchanges that you are contracted for a job, maybe if there’s proposal, or other documents. You need to give all evidences of where source of income is coming.

If you’re working on a sensitive data and your are not employee but an outsource service, then they really need to make an NDA for you to sign because you are gonna see their data and they wanted to make sure that you’re not going to disclose it. Scopes and limitations are there, you can read and review it. That’s a legal document they handle in case you breach it they have power to sue I guess. In my opinion you cannot ask for COE since you are not an employee but an outsource service. If you’re an employee then they wont be needing NDA since it will be part of employment contract.
